interpretation: UNSAT/capacity rejection is a strict necessary support-level obstruction under nonzero term semantics. Passing the filter does not imply B/C completion. The same-W deletion family is local, not a global cover of rank-19 supports.

logic.B_s: slice s is B/v-pure: active v factors lie in its row group
logic.C_s: slice s is C/w-pure: active w factors lie in its column group
logic.cap5_extension: cap3 sharing in both non-own row groups forces C-pure for a cap5 slice; column analogue forces B-pure; excess lower bound exceeding c-3 rejects
logic.sharing: shared nonzero term between different row groups forbids both B-pure; different column groups forbids both C-pure

purpose: support-level purity-side 2-SAT filter for E11 core, with cap-5 cap3-sharing extension

random_low_weight_calibration.warning: Random low-weight samples are not Wang-filtered and are only a calibration of the 2-SAT obstruction, not a complete support-frontier count.
